objective: Investigate and resolve why NorMuon/Anvil only match Adam; seek a substantial measured improvement through mechanism-driven PPO optimizer innovations.

benchmark_protocol.primary: Return averaged over trailing 200k environment steps at common 7.9M step.
secondary: Final 100 episode mean on succeeded >=7.9M runs.
Matched 1M, 2M, 4M, and 6M windows; reject last-window cherry picking.
Same-head Adam trunk control for natural-head attribution.
Same-floor zero-noise polar control for covariance filtering attribution.
benchmark_protocol.substantial_advantage_target: Seek roughly 10% or more over fresh Adam with consistent late-window improvement; this is an operational research target, not a statistical significance threshold or promise.
benchmark_protocol.uncertainty: One seed on one environment cannot establish robustness. Marginal differences do not resolve the user objective.

prior_evidence.interpretation: Marginal terminal-window difference does not demonstrate superiority; matching Adam is not task completion.
prior_evidence.original_history_heldout_gains: All 19 prior frozen-history heldout gains negative; cold optimizer replay is not fresh/warm benchmark evidence.

final_conclusion.interpretation: Rollout-clock Anvil produced a modest selected seed-1 improvement. No far-superior NorMuon/Anvil2 result demonstrated despite covariance, momentum-clock, head-geometry and policy-calibrated fractional iterations.
final_conclusion.recommendation: Retain v7: .0025 has more consistent early learning and .005 the best late primary window. Reject v6/v8/v9/v11 as Adam-beating improvements in these configurations. Do not blindly raise fractional LR after its matched policy-budget failure. Multi-seed confirmation needed for robustness; not run under seed-1 constraint.

final_mechanism_findings.outcome: Covariance filtering helps floored zero-noise polar control but fails Adam; lower multiplier better, larger LR cancelled. Raw held-gradient alignment greater than polar; covariance drifts. Fixed-rollout covariance and independence approximate; zero control not ideal exact polar.

Fresh-rollout slow rail gives +3.89% (.0025) or +5.69% (.005) on primary window. .005 lags at earlier windows. V11 zero-power entire 7964-episode curve exactly reproduces half rate, not independent replication.

Natural fixed-radius Beta heads fail stock Adam. Anvil beats equally harmful same-head Adam; smaller radius helps but insufficient. Head curvature approximate, attribution not stock optimizer superiority.

Sample-Fisher head amplitude matches local finite exact KL, resolving KFAC underestimation, but fresh returns worsen: Anvil 6382, Adam 6571, constant radius control 7103 primary. Calibration error real but remedy insufficient; head-only not total policy trust region.
Fractional spectral weighting improves selected tangent alignment but roughly quadruples first policy quadratic at equal parameter norm; no full training submitted, insufficient geometric gate.

Two GPU correction rounds match matrix-only expected-score Fisher budget before Adam auxiliaries. Fresh candidate 8074.10 below matched control 8632.02 (-6.46%) and Adam 8308.73 (-2.82%). Training logged 2M-4M q: reference .006745, scaled .006741, unscaled .027907. Thus amplitude correction works locally, benchmark hypothesis fails.
final_mechanism_findings.qualification: Three diagnostic chunks, first-order efficiency mean +9.5% but mixed; all finite heldout clipped-surrogate gains negative. Initial strict all-chunk gate explicitly relaxed for fresh falsification run, not met. Reference budget not exact or whole-policy KL. Rejected parameter steps still advance momentum intentionally.
